parameters.name: ContactIds
parameters.description: The ID of the alert contact.

parameters.name: ContactName
parameters.description: The name of the alert contact.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The number of the page to return.

parameters.name: Email
parameters.description: The email address of the alert contact.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: Phone
parameters.description: The mobile number of the alert contact.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region. Set the value to `cn-hangzhou`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms search-alert-contact --contact-name John_Doe --phone 138111100000 --email someone@example.com --current-page 1 --page-size 20 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --contact-ids 12345 --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
